papers.title: In Situ Controlled Surface Microstructure of 3D Printed Ti Alloy to Promote Its Osteointegration.
papers.abstract: It is well known that three-dimensional (3D) printing is an emerging technology used to produce customized implants and surface characteristics of implants, strongly deciding their osseointegration ability. In this study, Ti alloy microspheres were printed under selected rational printing parameters in order to tailor the surface micro-characteristics of the printed implants during additive manufacturing by an in situ, controlled way. The laser path and hatching space were responsible for the appearance of the stripy structure (S), while the bulbous structure (B) and bulbous⁻stripy composite surface (BS) were determined by contour scanning. A nano-sized structure could be superposed by hydrothermal treatment. The cytocompatibility was evaluated by culturing Mouse calvaria-derived preosteoblastic cells (MC3T3-E1). The results showed that three typical microstructured surfaces, S, B, and BS, could be achieved by varying the 3D printing parameters. Moreover, the osteogenic differentiation potential of the S, B, and BS surfaces could be significantly enhanced, and the addition of nano-sized structures could be further improved. The BS surface with nano-sized structure demonstrated the optimum osteogenic differentiation potential. The present research demonstrated an in situ, controlled way to tailor and optimize the surface structures in micro-size during the 3D printing process for an implant with higher osseointegration ability.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文通过调控3D打印参数原位控制钛合金表面微结构以促进骨整合，与用户对增材制造生物医用植入物的骨整合研究方向直接相关。
llm.why_not_core: Paper does not quantify stress shielding, stiffness matching, or any mechanical testing (fatigue or static compression), and lacks porous structure design linking to implant mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 通过原位控制3D打印表面微结构提升钛合金植入体的骨整合能力。
summary_zh.method: 调整激光路径和扫描间距，结合水热处理构建三种微米级表面形貌及纳米级叠加结构。
summary_zh.result: 条状-球状复合表面叠加纳米结构展现出最优的成骨分化潜力。
summary_zh.validation: 小鼠颅骨前成骨细胞培养评估细胞相容性和成骨分化。

summary_en.motivation: To tailor surface microstructures of Ti alloy implants during 3D printing for enhanced osseointegration without post-processing.
summary_en.method: Laser path and hatching space were varied to produce stripy, bulbous, and composite surface textures, with nano-features added via hydrothermal treatment.
summary_en.result: The bulbous-stripy composite surface with nano-structure showed the highest osteogenic differentiation potential.
summary_en.validation: In vitro cytocompatibility and osteogenic differentiation were assessed using MC3T3-E1 preosteoblastic cells.

papers.title: Scalable Grouped Gaussian Processes via Direct Cholesky Functional Representations
papers.abstract: We consider multi-task regression models where observations are assumed to be a linear combination of several latent node and weight functions, all drawn from Gaussian process (GP) priors that allow nonzero covariance between grouped latent functions. We show that when these grouped functions are conditionally independent given a group-dependent pivot, it is possible to parameterize the prior through sparse Cholesky factors directly, hence avoiding their computation during inference. Furthermore, we establish that kernels that are multiplicatively separable over input points give rise to such sparse parameterizations naturally without any additional assumptions. Finally, we extend the use of these sparse structures to approximate posteriors within variational inference, further improving scalability on the number of functions. We test our approach on multi-task datasets concerning distributed solar forecasting and show that it outperforms several multi-task GP baselines and that our sparse specifications achieve the same or better accuracy than non-sparse counterparts.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文专注于多任务高斯过程的稀疏化方法，与用户关注的有限元代理建模方向无直接关联。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address finite element surrogate modeling, constraint handling, uncertainty quantification for design optimization, or biomechanical implant applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高多任务高斯过程的可扩展性，避免计算稠密Cholesky分解。
summary_zh.method: 利用条件独立性和可分离核直接参数化稀疏Cholesky因子。
summary_zh.result: 在分布式太阳能预测任务上优于多任务GP基线，稀疏版本精度不降。
summary_zh.validation: 在太阳能预测数据集上对比多个多任务GP基线。

summary_en.motivation: To improve scalability of multi-task Gaussian processes by avoiding dense Cholesky decomposition during inference.
summary_en.method: Parameterize the prior via sparse Cholesky factors directly using conditional independence and multiplicatively separable kernels.
summary_en.result: The proposed method outperforms several multi-task GP baselines on distributed solar forecasting, with sparse specifications achieving comparable or better accuracy.
summary_en.validation: Empirical evaluation on multi-task solar forecasting datasets against standard multi-task GP baselines.
